title: Concept: Pipfile source with TLS verification off
description: Pipfile declares a `verify_ssl = false` source, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `verify_ssl = false` source.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Pipfile (pypi).
risk: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `verify_ssl = false` source.
